reason: Raises timeout-minutes from 65 to 87 to fit ops/ci_tests.sh's pytest bound for a frozen-inclusive run, raised from 50 to 72 minutes because that suite takes about 51 minutes on an AMD EPYC 7763 runner (runs 45512966117 and 45747873168); the live-files bound stays 50. The steps run the same tests, so the budgeted live-files run costs what it did. A frozen-inclusive run (a release cut, a freeze exception, the weekly nightly) on a slow CPU now finishes in about 51 minutes instead of being killed at 50 and rerun, and a hung one can use up to 22 more minutes before its bound ends it.
